title: Golden Figure in Basin
description: A golden three-headed figure sits in a large copper basin filled with yellow liquid. The figure has closed eyes, a wreath on its head, one hand on its chest and the other holding a quill that drips yellow, with light beams shining down from above.
prompt: A golden three headed figure with closed eyes and a wreath sits inside a large round copper basin filled with thick yellow liquid. One hand rests on its chest while the other holds a quill dripping yellow. Bright beams of light shine down from a circular window above. The curved walls are covered in painted marks and runes. Scattered papers lie on the floor around the basin. The entire scene uses rich yellow gold and copper tones.
